description: This file defines a YOLOv3 object detection model in PyTorch, including classes for detection layers, convolutional layers, and the overall model architecture, along with associated methods.

classes.name: DetectionLayer
classes.description: A PyTorch module implementing detection logic for YOLOv3, handling anchor boxes, grid calculations, and prediction transformations.

classes.name: ConvLayer
classes.description: A wrapper around nn.Conv2d with optional batch normalization and activation, used to build the YOLOv3 architecture.

classes.name: YoloV3
classes.description: The main YOLOv3 model class, assembling convolutional layers, detection layers, and upsampling for multi-scale object detection.

methods.name: __get_anchors
methods.description: Calculates anchor box tensors based on provided anchor sizes and masks.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Defines the forward pass for DetectionLayer and YoloV3, transforming inputs into detection outputs.

methods.name: get_loss_layers
methods.description: Returns the detection layers used for computing loss during training.

methods.name: __route_layer
methods.description: Concatenates feature maps for feature fusion in the network.

methods.name: __shortcut_layer
methods.description: Implements residual shortcut connections with optional activation.
